scope: fixed-teacher causal history diagnostic; no training or new model selection
teacher_selection_rule: lexicographically smallest id among existing train push rows; no performance selection

isolation.limits: Numerically distinct local physical configurations, not unseen layouts or a generalization proof. Historical MJB equivalence not exhaustively checked. Teacher config deliberately shared across new train/validation.

analysis: Offline frozen MLP/ESN on teacher-visited observations; raw action and safety-filter requests by phase, no student closed-loop score
